identity.name: Mileforum
identity.description: A SaaS platform offering a specialized AI apprentice that observes your work and adapts to your decision-making style.

core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix professional SaaS reliability with cosmic/geometric aesthetics.
Emotion First: Convey intelligence and focus.
Content is King: Every section must drive the narrative of 'The Apprentice that learns from you'.
Contrast: High contrast Yellow/Blue on Deep Black.

headings.usage: All section titles, hero headlines, and major callouts.

colors.palette_notes: Use the primary Yellow (#FACC15) for main CTAs and key highlights. Use Accent Blue (#3B82F6) for secondary links, icons, and 'cosmic' glows. Background is strictly #09090B (Zinc 950).

layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-24. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
layout.grid_system: Bento Grid for Domains. Split layout for Hero. Zig-zag for 'How it Works'.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Primary buttons: Yellow bg, Black text. Secondary: Outline or Ghost with White text.
buttons.interaction: Hover: Scale up slightly (scale-105), brightness boost.

cards.style: Flat background (#09090B or #18181B), 1px border (#27272A). No heavy shadows. Use 'glow' effects on hover.
cards.hover: Border color changes to Primary or Accent. Subtle inner glow.

inputs.style: Shadcn Input. Dark background, light border. Focus ring: Yellow or Blue.

visual_enhancers.background_texture: Cosmic noise overlay. Use a subtle noise pattern or the provided cosmic image with low opacity/blending.
visual_enhancers.geometric_shapes: Use abstract geometric shapes (triangles, hexagons, lines) as section dividers or background elements. CSS-based or SVG.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use box-shadow or drop-shadow to create 'neon' glows around key elements (CTAs, active cards).

hero_background.description: Abstract blue cosmic swirls. Use as a background overlay with low opacity or blend mode to add depth.

hero_main.description: Professional woman working late, focused. Represents the user being observed by the AI apprentice.

motion.guidelines: Use 'AnimatePresence' for modals. Use 'whileHover' for cards and buttons. Page sections should 'fade in up' (opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 20 -> 0) as they scroll into view.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on Yellow background is Black. Text on Blue background is White. Text on Black background is White/Gray.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (Yellow or Blue) for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Cosmic Noise' by using a fixed background image with low opacity or a CSS radial gradient pattern.
Use Shadcn components for: Button, Card, Input, Label, Select, Accordion, Dialog, Sheet, Separator, Badge.
Customize Shadcn components to match the Dark/Yellow/Blue theme (override default radius and colors in tailwind.config.js or via utility classes).
Ensure the 'Register' form is functional (mocked submission) and captures the 'Domain' selection.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all headings to give a technical/developer vibe.
Create a 'sticky' navigation bar with a glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur).
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in '/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx'.
